```{python}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import plotnine as p9
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score, confusion_matrix, roc_auc_score,
    precision_score, recall_score, f1_score, classification_report
)
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

```

```{python}
#| label: load-data
#| include: false

train = pd.read_csv("CAH-201803-train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("CAH-201803-test.csv")

target_col = "political_affiliation"
y = train[target_col]
X = train.drop([target_col, "id_num"], axis=1)

X_test = test.drop("id_num", axis=1)
test_ids = test["id_num"]

X_train, X_valid, y_train, y_valid = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=544
)

numeric_features = X_train.select_dtypes(include=["int64", "float64"]).columns.tolist()
categorical_features = X_train.select_dtypes(include=["object"]).columns.tolist()

numeric_transformer = Pipeline(steps=[
    ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")),
    ("scaler", StandardScaler())
])

categorical_transformer = Pipeline(steps=[
    ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="most_frequent")),
    ("onehot", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore", sparse_output=False))
])

preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(
    transformers=[
        ("num", numeric_transformer, numeric_features),
        ("cat", categorical_transformer, categorical_features)
    ]
)

```


```{python}
#| label: train-model
#| include: false

pipe = Pipeline(steps=[
    ("preprocess", preprocessor),
    ("model", LogisticRegression(solver="saga", max_iter=5000, random_state=544))
])

pipe.fit(X_train, y_train)

y_pred = pipe.predict(X_valid)
y_proba = pipe.predict_proba(X_valid)

accuracy = accuracy_score(y_valid, y_pred)
precision = precision_score(y_valid, y_pred, average="weighted", zero_division=0)
recall = recall_score(y_valid, y_pred, average="weighted", zero_division=0)
f1 = f1_score(y_valid, y_pred, average="weighted", zero_division=0)

try:
    roc_auc = roc_auc_score(y_valid, y_proba, multi_class="ovr", average="weighted")
except:
    roc_auc = None

conf_matrix = confusion_matrix(y_valid, y_pred)
classes = sorted(y.unique())

y_test_pred = pipe.predict(X_test)

submission = pd.DataFrame({
    "id_num": test_ids,
    target_col: y_test_pred
})

```

```{python}
#| title: "Class Distribution (Training Data)"

target_counts = y.value_counts().reset_index()
target_counts.columns = ['Class', 'Count']

(p9.ggplot(target_counts, p9.aes(x="Class", y="Count", fill="Class"))
 + p9.geom_col(width=0.6)
 + p9.geom_text(p9.aes(label="Count"), va="bottom", size=10, color="black")
 + p9.labs(x="", y="Number of Samples", title="Is data balanced?")
 + p9.scale_fill_manual(values={
     "Democrat": "#3498db", 
     "Republican": "#e74c3c", 
     "Independent": "#2ecc71"
 })
 + p9.theme(figure_size=(6, 4), legend_position="none",
            panel_background=p9.element_rect(fill="white"),
            panel_grid_major=p9.element_line(color="#ecf0f1"))
).draw()

```

```{python}
#| title: "Prediction Confidence"

(p9.ggplot(confidence_df, p9.aes(x="Confidence", fill="..count.."))
 + p9.geom_histogram(bins=30, color="white", alpha=0.8)
 + p9.scale_fill_gradient(low="#3498db", high="#e74c3c")
 + p9.labs(x="Model Confidence Score", y="Count", title="Is model confident?")
 + p9.theme(figure_size=(6, 4), legend_position="none",
            panel_background=p9.element_rect(fill="white"),
            panel_grid_major=p9.element_line(color="#ecf0f1"))
).draw()

```

### Column

```{python}
#| include: false

# Create confusion matrix dataframe
cm_df = pd.DataFrame(conf_matrix, index=classes, columns=classes)

```

```{python}
#| title: "Confusion Matrix (Validation)"

cm_long = cm_df.reset_index().melt(id_vars='index', var_name='Predicted', value_name='Count')
cm_long.columns = ['Actual', 'Predicted', 'Count']

(p9.ggplot(cm_long, p9.aes(x="Predicted", y="Actual", fill="Count"))
 + p9.geom_tile(color="white", size=2)
 + p9.geom_text(p9.aes(label="Count"), size=12, color="white")
 + p9.scale_fill_gradient(low="#e8f8f5", high="#27ae60")
 + p9.labs(x="Predicted Class", y="Actual Class", title="Where does model confuse classes?")
 + p9.theme(figure_size=(7, 5), legend_position="right",
            panel_background=p9.element_rect(fill="white"),
            panel_grid_major=p9.element_blank())
).draw()


```

# Detailed Analysis {#detailed}

## Row {height=50%}

### Column {width=50%}


```{python}
#| title: "Per-Class Performance Metrics"

report = classification_report(y_valid, y_pred, output_dict=True)
report_df = pd.DataFrame(report).transpose()
report_df = report_df[report_df.index.isin(classes)].reset_index()
report_df.columns = ['Class', 'Precision', 'Recall', 'F1-Score', 'Support']

(p9.ggplot(report_df.melt(id_vars=['Class'], value_vars=['Precision', 'Recall', 'F1-Score']),
           p9.aes(x="Class", y="value", fill="variable"))
 + p9.geom_col(position="dodge", width=0.7)
 + p9.scale_y_continuous(limits=[0, 1])
 + p9.scale_fill_manual(values={
     "Precision": "#3498db", 
     "Recall": "#e74c3c", 
     "F1-Score": "#2ecc71"
 })
 + p9.labs(x="", y="Score", fill="Metric", title="Which classes perform best?")
 + p9.theme(figure_size=(6, 4), legend_position="bottom",
            panel_background=p9.element_rect(fill="white"),
            panel_grid_major=p9.element_line(color="#ecf0f1"))
).draw()

```
